import * as pulumi from '@pulumi/pulumi';
import * as aws from '@pulumi/aws';

const config = new pulumi.Config();

// var.region
const region = config.get("region") ?? "us-east-1";

// var.environment
const environment = config.get("environment") ?? "dev";

// aws_s3_bucket.assets
const assetsS3Bucket = new aws.s3.Bucket("assets", {
  bucket: `openiac-assets-${environment}`,
  tags: {"Environment": environment},
});

// aws_sqs_queue.jobs
const jobsSqsQueue = new aws.sqs.Queue("jobs", {
  messageRetentionSeconds: 1209600,
  name: "openiac-jobs",
  visibilityTimeoutSeconds: 300,
});

// aws_vpc.main
const mainVpc = new aws.ec2.Vpc("main", {
  cidrBlock: "10.0.0.0/16",
  enableDnsHostnames: true,
  enableDnsSupport: true,
  tags: {"Environment": environment, "Name": `openiac-${environment}`},
});

// aws_security_group.web
const webSecurityGroup = new aws.ec2.SecurityGroup("web", {
  description: "Allow HTTP from anywhere",
  name: "openiac-web",
  tags: {"Name": "openiac-web"},
  vpcId: mainVpc.id,
  egress: [{ cidrBlocks: ["0.0.0.0/0"], fromPort: 0, protocol: "-1", toPort: 0 }],
  ingress: [{ cidrBlocks: ["0.0.0.0/0"], fromPort: 80, protocol: "tcp", toPort: 80 }],
});

// aws_subnet.public
const publicSubnet = new aws.ec2.Subnet("public", {
  availabilityZone: `${region}a`,
  cidrBlock: "10.0.1.0/24",
  mapPublicIpOnLaunch: true,
  tags: {"Name": "openiac-public"},
  vpcId: mainVpc.id,
});

// aws_instance.web
const webInstance = new aws.ec2.Instance("web", {
  ami: "ami-0123456789abcdef0",
  instanceType: "t3.micro",
  subnetId: publicSubnet.id,
  tags: {"Name": "openiac-web"},
  vpcSecurityGroupIds: [webSecurityGroup.id],
});

// output.bucket_arn
export const bucketArn = assetsS3Bucket.arn;

// output.instance_ip
export const instanceIp = webInstance.publicIp;
